name: MemoryRecallTool
description: 按语义或时间范围检索连续性记录、分层时间摘要和物理 episode 证据，并沿来源引用逐层下钻。

query.description: Natural-language description of the learned fact to recall.

refs.description: Exact senera://continuity-learning, senera://memory-digest, senera://memory-episode, or senera://memory-source references to read.

before.description: Completed turns to include before each matched physical episode.

after.description: Completed turns to include after each matched physical episode.

from.description: Start of a historical range as YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339. Date-only boundaries use the configured world time zone.

to.description: Inclusive end date as YYYY-MM-DD, or exclusive RFC 3339 end instant, for a historical range.

sources.Title: Learning record ledger
sources.Description: Learned memory, hierarchical temporal digests, and their physical episode evidence.

search.Summary: 检索连续性学习记录；宽时间范围优先返回月/日/片段摘要，并可沿引用读取物理证据。

Capabilities.Title: 分层记忆召回
Capabilities.Description: Rank learned records and select the coarsest complete temporal digests before drilling into physical episodes.

UseCases: 按日期范围回忆时优先读取月、日和片段摘要；需要细节时沿摘要 sourceRefs 下钻到 episode 和物理来源。
Examples: 总结最近三个月聊过的内容
根据这些记忆来源确认我的偏好
召回关于运动和天气的条件
读取命中事件前后两轮
Avoid: 宽时间范围不要直接展开全部历史正文；先用时间摘要，再按需解引用来源。

Projection.SummaryTemplate:
{% for e in evidence %}- evidenceUri: {{ e.evidenceUri }} {{ e.slots.kind }}: {{ e.slots.summary }}
{% endfor %}

{% for e in evidence %}- evidenceUri: {{ e.evidenceUri }} {{ e.slots.granularity }} digest: {{ e.slots.summary }}
{% endfor %}

Summary.Template:
{% for block in projections %}{{ block.summary }}
{% endfor %}
Summary.ArtifactTemplate:
{% for block in projections %}{{ block.artifact }}
{% endfor %}
